name: Mind the Offline Provider
tagline: The cheapest route is a dead one.
brief: Route to the cheapest provider that is actually online — the cheapest overall is offline.
context: Provider A has the lowest fee but it is offline. Sending payments there fails.
narrative: The starter rule routes everything to Provider A because it is cheapest by fee. But A is offline — a payment can't go through a provider that isn't there. Fix the routing so payments only go to a provider that can actually process them, and still keep the cost down.
objective: Process every payment with no failures by avoiding the offline provider.
learningObjective: Constraints before optimization: filter to what is possible, then choose the cheapest of those.
intelligenceExplanation: The provider cards establish that A is cheaper but offline, while B is online. Replace the broken route-to-A rule with the available fallback provider.
hint: Route to the available fallback: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
hints: Look at the provider cards — one is marked offline. Routing there fails.
The starter rule sends everything to A. Change it: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b.
B is the cheaper available provider in this fixed scenario.
